notes: HD 271791 is the only individually identified star that the paper explicitly treats as a Galactic-unbound candidate: it is called a hyper-runaway/hypervelocity star, with a stated rest-frame velocity lower limit exceeding the escape velocity at its location (T:p3-b5; T:p4-b1). It is recorded as follow_up because this status was presented from Heber et al. (2008) and then examined further. The unnamed 2005 group with rest-frame velocities above the escape velocity (T:p3-b4) lacks individual star identifiers. The membership of the ten ≈400 km/s high-velocity group is not individually listed, and its “hyper-runaway stars?” figure label/question does not establish a current unbound status for every member (T:p3-b2; T:p5-b2; I:p3-b0). SB 357, EC 20252−3137, and Hip 77131 (T:p2-b9) are discussed only as flight-time/lifetime anomalies, without an explicit retained Galactic-unbound claim.

HD 271791: At T:p4-b1, the paper reports an ejection velocity of approximately 400 km/s for HD 271791; this is an ejection velocity relative to the star's standard of rest, not the requested total Galactic rest-frame speed, so it is not mapped to `galactic_rest_frame_velocity`. The 650 km/s value at T:p4-b2 is a scenario-dependent upper bound rather than a measured value.
